definition: Lasting for a very short time; transient and fleeting in nature.
sentence: The ephemeral beauty of the cherry blossoms drew crowds for only a single week each spring.

definition: Present, appearing, or found everywhere at the same time.
sentence: Smartphones have become so ubiquitous that we rarely notice the people staring at them.

definition: Dealing with things sensibly and realistically in a practical, results-driven way.
sentence: Her pragmatic approach to budgeting kept the project on schedule despite repeated setbacks.

definition: Having mixed or contradictory feelings about someone or something at the same time.
sentence: He felt ambivalent about the promotion: flattered, but wary of the longer hours.

definition: Truthful and straightforward; honestly open in expression.
sentence: In a rare candid moment, the chairman admitted the company had moved too slowly.

definition: Expressed clearly; easy to understand. Also: showing clear thought.
sentence: Her lucid explanation of the proof made the whole class lean forward.

definition: Showing great attention to detail; very careful and precise.
sentence: The restorer's meticulous brushwork brought the faded portrait back to life.

definition: Briefly and clearly expressed; concise without losing meaning.
sentence: The judge praised the lawyer's succinct closing argument.

definition: Very weak, slight, or insubstantial; lacking firm foundation.
sentence: The connection between the two events was tenuous at best.

definition: To clear someone of blame or suspicion; to prove a claim or judgment correct.
sentence: The new evidence vindicated the journalist whose story had been dismissed for years.

definition: To examine or inspect closely and thoroughly.
sentence: Auditors scrutinized every receipt before signing off on the accounts.

definition: To publicly recommend or support a particular policy, action, or cause.
sentence: The council member continued to advocate for safer crossings near the school.

definition: To perceive or recognize something, often with effort or judgment.
sentence: From the balcony she could just discern the outline of the harbor through the fog.

definition: To make something clear; to explain in detail.
sentence: The professor used a single diagram to elucidate the entire system.

definition: To make something less severe, harmful, or painful.
sentence: The new shield was designed to mitigate damage from sudden impact.

definition: A typical example or model of something; a framework for thinking about a subject.
sentence: Their study became the paradigm for how cognitive load is measured in classrooms.

definition: The art of effective or persuasive speaking and writing; sometimes, language with little substance.
sentence: Behind the campaign's rhetoric, voters wanted to see a concrete policy plan.

definition: A subtle distinction or shade of meaning, expression, or tone.
sentence: Translating poetry requires close attention to every nuance of the original.

definition: General agreement reached by a group as a whole.
sentence: After hours of discussion, the committee finally reached a consensus.

definition: Something that deviates from what is standard, normal, or expected.
sentence: Researchers flagged the temperature reading as a probable anomaly in the dataset.

definition: A statement or idea taken to be true and used as the basis for an argument.
sentence: The whole policy rests on the premise that consumers will switch providers easily.

definition: One side or aspect of something, especially a multifaceted subject or object.
sentence: Her job touches almost every facet of the organization, from hiring to design.

definition: Relevant or applicable to a particular matter; appropriate to the situation.
sentence: Please keep your remarks brief and pertinent to the agenda.

definition: Involving or requiring strenuous effort; difficult and tiring.
sentence: The arduous climb to the summit took the team three full days.

definition: Acting with or showing care and thought for the future; wisely cautious.
sentence: It would be prudent to keep three months' expenses in reserve.

definition: Most noticeable or important; standing out from the surrounding context.
sentence: She summarized the salient points of the report in under a minute.

definition: To deliberately make something unclear, obscure, or harder to understand.
sentence: The contract's dense legalese seemed designed to obfuscate the actual fees.

definition: To confirm or give support to a statement, theory, or finding.
sentence: Two independent witnesses corroborated her account of the incident.

definition: Giving a lot of information clearly and in a few words; brief but comprehensive.
sentence: Editors prized her concise prose; nothing was wasted on the page.

definition: Done consciously and intentionally; carefully considered and not impulsive.
sentence: Every brushstroke was deliberate, the result of decades of practice.
